answer_2.quote: We follow previous work ... compute Self-BLEU ... as a metric of diversity. ... we first train a RoBERTa-Large model on the standard training dataset, which is then used as a validator to evaluate the synthetic dataset.

answer_4.quote: We invite 4 experts to participate in the evaluation and each participant is randomly assigned 25 generated samples (100 samples in total) for each decoding strategy.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators rate each generated sample on correctness (whether the label matches the content) and naturalness (fluency and similarity to human text).
